# A Sense of Place Magazine

> An independent Australian magazine publishing beautifully written journalism on politics, social movements, photography, and books with a focus on government accountability and alternative perspectives.

A Sense of Place Magazine is an independent Australian publication founded by journalist John Stapleton, offering in-depth coverage of Australian politics, protests, and social issues. The magazine also operates A Sense of Place Publishing, providing editorial and design services, and maintains an active presence on Substack and X (Twitter).

## Key Topics

- Convoy to Canberra
- Australian Politics

## Core Magazine & Publishing

- [A Sense of Place Magazine – Homepage](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com): Homepage for independent Australian magazine covering politics, social movements, photography and books
- [Contact & About](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/about): About page and contact information for A Sense of Place Magazine and Publishing
- [Publishing Services](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/publishing-services): A Sense of Place Publishing services including editing, design, and self-publishing
- [The Journalism of John Stapleton](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/the-journalism-of-john-stapleton): Archive and profile of journalist John Stapleton's independent news work

## Convoy to Canberra Series

- [Convoy to Canberra: One. A Time for All Time](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-chapter-one-a-time-for-all-time): First article in Convoy to Canberra series on COVID lockdowns and government accountability
- [Convoy to Canberra. Two. From All the Lands We Come](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-two-from-all-the-lands-we-come): Coverage of Convoy to Canberra grassroots activism and crowd analysis
- [Convoy to Canberra. Three. The Fulcrum Points of History](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-three-the-fulcrum-points-of-history): Analysis of Convoy to Canberra as pivotal moment in Australian political history
- [Convoy to Canberra. Four. The Prime Minister Who Destroyed Australia](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-four-the-prime-minister-who-destroyed-australia): Political commentary on Scott Morrison and Convoy to Canberra protests
- [Convoy to Canberra. Five. We Will Wash Away Tyranny](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-five-we-will-wash-away-tyranny): Analysis of Convoy to Canberra mass demonstration and government resistance
- [Convoy to Canberra. Six. Joy and Calamity, Brutality and Kindness](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-six-joy-and-calamity-brutality-and-kindness): Article on Convoy to Canberra lockdown protests, vaccine mandates and civil unrest
- [Convoy to Canberra. Seven. The Meek Shall Inherit the Earth](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/convoy-to-canberra-seven-the-meek-shall-inherit-the-earth): John Stapleton's journalism on Convoy to Canberra protests and demonstrations

## Featured Articles

- [The Long Drive: Goodbye Road](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/the-long-drive-goodbye-road): Personal essay on road travel through Australian outback exploring grief and place
- [Vale Johnny Allen](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/vale-johnny-allen): Obituary and interview with Johnny Allen, Nimbin Aquarius Festival founder
- [It took just 60 years for red foxes to colonise Australia from Victoria to the Pilbara](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/it-took-just-60-years-for-red-foxes-to-colonise-australia-from-victoria-to-the-pilbara): Article on red fox colonization and ecological impact on Australian native species
- [Criminals are weaponising vulnerabilities in Australia's construction industry to steal millions of dollars](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/criminals-are-weaponising-vulnerabilities-in-australias-construction-industry-to-steal-millions-of-dollars): Investigation into business email compromise fraud targeting Australian construction industry
- [Memorial Drinks for Dr Stephen Edwards](https://asenseofplacemagazine.com/evil-conjectures-the-australian-doctor-accused-of-murdering-his-mother): True crime article on Dr Stephen Edwards and Evil Conjectures murder case
